Hi Alex / Priya — thanks, and apologies for the slightly delayed reply — I was confirming the latest timelines. Below is a concise summary of our vulnerability management and testing posture; happy to walk through live.

Pen test and compliance:
- Third-party pen test: annual, last completed Nov 2025. We can share a redacted PDF summary (attached) and provide the full report under NDA.
- SOC 2: Type II completed Nov 2025; attestation and scope doc available on request.
- HIPAA / BAA: we support BAAs; we'll surface our standard template if you indicate BAA is required for the pilot.

Vulnerability management (triage & remediation SLAs):
- Critical (CVSS >= 9.0 / active exploit): initial triage within 4 hours; mitigation plan in 24 hours; target remediation (patch or compensating control) within 7 days.
- High (CVSS 7.0-8.9): initial triage within 24 hours; mitigation plan within 72 hours; target remediation within 30 days.
- Medium (CVSS 4.0-6.9): triage within 72 hours; target remediation within 90 days.
- Low (CVSS <4.0): triage within 7 days; remediation as scheduled in normal release cadence (typically within 90 days).

Scanning cadence & evidence retention:
- Internal: weekly SAST/DAST scans against pre-prod and CI pipeline.
- External: monthly authenticated vulnerability scans against prod (targeting customer-facing services).
- Third-party: annual penetration test and occasional targeted engagements after significant feature releases.
- Evidence: we retain vulnerability tickets, remediation evidence, and scan outputs for 24 months (longer retention available under contract).

Disclosure policy & coordination:
- Coordinated disclosure: standard 90-day default disclosure window for external researchers; we coordinate timelines with affected customers where relevant.
- We operate a coordinated vulnerability disclosure process (CVD); we do not run a public bounty program currently but evaluate critical reports case-by-case and engage external researchers under NDA when needed.

Next steps / logistical notes:

- We will pre-fill the vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx and return within 48 business hours; Marissa and Stephanie will coordinate.
- If FintechCo needs the full pen test report we can proceed under an NDA — I'll loop legal once you confirm.
- Proposed follow-up: 30-min call next Wed 11:00 AM PST to review the summary and go through any questionnaire gaps. Please confirm availability.

If you want to escalate any specific findings now, send them to security@redwood.com and I will prioritize triage.

Best,
